print: all R3 PETG/TPU prints in output_R3/DRAFT/STL except V4_R3_Tub_TPU and V4_R3_Lid_TPU_2mm (replaced by the PC body) and V4_R3_Wedgelet_Block_PETG_L/R (replaced by their _PCbody variants)

accepted_risks.weapon_motor.diameter_mm: Upright L rear relief uses the SURPASS C3536 catalogue diameter 35 mm + 1 mm clearance. A larger real can needs the relief filed.
accepted_risks.dead_shaft.diameter_mm: Upright bore 8.2 mm is the ISO clearance for an M8 bolt; the bolt is a standard part.
accepted_risks.weapon_motor.mount_holes_yz_mm: M06 motor holes use the SURPASS C3536 catalogue cross pattern 19 x 25 mm (±9.5, ±12.5 from the shaft). A different real pattern needs a new plate or hand-drilled holes.
accepted_risks.weapon_motor.mount_thread_diameter_mm: M06 motor holes are Ø3.4 clearance for the catalogue M3 thread.
accepted_risks.weapon_motor.boss_diameter_mm: M06 boss hole Ø10.5 is for a guessed 10 mm boss (not in the catalogue). A larger real boss needs the hole filed or reamed.
accepted_risks.drive_Front_L.diameter_mm: M06 outline clears the catalogue Ø25 mm front drive motor.
accepted_risks.drive_Front_R.diameter_mm: M06 outline clears the catalogue Ø25 mm front drive motor.
accepted_risks.weapon_motor.shaft_diameter_mm: Motor pulley bore Ø4 from the SURPASS manual; set-screw seat at the catalogue 20 mm projection.
accepted_risks.weapon_motor.shaft_projection_mm: Pulley position uses the catalogue 20 mm shaft projection.
accepted_risks.drive motors (all 4): JB361 drawing values: face holes 2×M3 17 mm apart, boss Ø7×2.5, Ø25 × 49.8 can, shaft Ø4 D-flat 0.5 deep on the outer 8 mm of an 11.5 mm projection. Hub engagement 7.8 mm (min 7.5): a shaft shorter than 11.2 mm fails. Mass kept at 110 g each (ORTECH 100 g is shipping weight).
accepted_risks.battery, ESC, ESP32, IMU: Catalogue outlines (GNB8503S80A 63×30×24, Skywalker 40A, ESP32 30-pin, GY-521). DRV8871 boards, disconnect and hall sensor use the R3 design envelopes.
accepted_risks.fit values: Chosen without coupons: insert M3 hole Ø4.4 (OD 5 insert), M2.5 hole Ø3.2 (OD 3.6), tyre ID 43.8, D-bore +0.10/+0.05, hinge +0.2, nut pocket +0.2. If an insert spins or a tyre slips, reprint that part.
accepted_risks.mass with splash cover: Expected case 1998.9 g (1.1 g under 2000 g); nominal 1985.0 g. A 3.1 mm PC sheet or denser prints exceed 2000 g: weigh the robot; the splash cover (13 g + 1.4 g strip) is removable.
